failure_class.instructions: What is the most likely cause of this CI failure, based only on `log_tail` and `changed_files`?

criteria.dependency: A package, image or artifact could not be resolved, downloaded or built
criteria.credential: A token, secret or permission was missing, expired or rejected
criteria.runner: The runner ran out of disk, memory or time, or the job was cancelled by the platform
criteria.code: A test, lint or compile step failed because of the changed files
criteria.unknown: The log does not show enough to decide

retry_may_help.instructions: Would re-running the job without any change have a reasonable chance of passing?

criteria.true: The failure is an expired token, a transient network error or a runner interruption
criteria.false: The failure is a failing test, a compile error or a missing dependency that a retry would hit again

touches_pipeline.instructions: Do the `changed_files` include CI or pipeline definitions such as workflow, Dockerfile or build configuration files?

criteria.true: A workflow, Dockerfile, Makefile or build configuration file is in the list
criteria.false: Only application source or test files are in the list
